system.description:
• Effect: A new Performance option, costing 1 use, out of combat: creatures who can see and hear you (2 at 4th, 4 at 6th, 10 at 12th) make a Will save or are held, Incapacitated, while you perform and for a round after. An obvious threat, such as an attack on a held creature or its allies, breaks the effect.
  • 8th level: you may implant a Suggestion in a held creature as part of the performance (Will save to resist).
  • 18th level: you may implant a Mass Suggestion in every held creature instead.

activities.name: Fascinate
activities.text: A Performance option (1 use), out of combat: up to {1:2, 6:4, 12:10} creatures that can see and hear you make a Will save or are held, Incapacitated, while you perform and for a round after. An obvious threat breaks it.

activities.name: Suggestion
activities.text: Implant a Suggestion in a held creature as part of the performance (Will save to resist).

activities.name: Sway Crowd
activities.text: While performing (1 Performance use): all listeners save or are Incapacitated while you perform: up to {13:20, 16:40, 19:80, 22:160} Levels of targets, lowest Level first, any humanoid regardless of language. A creature that is attacked or sees an ally attacked may save again at once.{22: A held crowd may be given a Suggestion that lasts a week.}

activities.name: Mass Suggestion
activities.text: Implant a Mass Suggestion in every held creature instead (Will save to resist).
